Naver Series,  [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/51134327), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1746011471), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/barotoon06)

**Official Translations:**  
[Indonesian](https://www.webtoons.com/id/romance/how-to-train-celebrity/list?title_no=2491)  

Oh Mi-soon is an FD working for the NBC Broadcasting Station Drama Bureau. FD refers to "Floor Director" in foreign countries, that is, stage director of the concert hall, but in Korea, it refers to auxiliary production mainly done by broadcasting stations. In other words, it is a representative 3D industry that is in charge of all kinds of errands under the producer of broadcasting stations. Mi-soon, who lived alone with her grandmother in the countryside and graduated from the Department of Theater and Film at a local junior college, came to Seoul a year ago with a dream of Cheong-woon to shoot a drama with her own scenario. Mi-soon, who is lucky to become the FD of the mini-series "Sweet Villain," directed by producer Cha Jin-hyuk, who was usually respected, and starring top star Kang Eun-ho.  
But for a while! At the time of the attempt, Mi-soon, a mistake-star, was often broken by producer Cha Jin-hyuk, who is famous for being tough at broadcasting stations, and Kang Eun-ho, who is about 10 times more ill than Cha Jin-hyuk, was properly stamped and even got hit by a roman in front of all staff watching...
